$schema: Each key is a death cause id (condition id or starvation, hazard, drift, hull_fire, adrift). Value: array of variants using {name}; adrift has no {name}.
space-dysentery: {name} has died of space dysentery. Nobody is sure how.
{name} has died of space dysentery. The recycler has been asked to explain itself.
{name} has died of space dysentery. It was a long week and a short goodbye.
hull-mold-fever: {name} has died of hull mold fever. The mold declined to comment.
{name} has died of hull mold fever. The walls are, somehow, thriving.
{name} has died of hull mold fever. The ship has been scrubbed in their honor.
cryo-fever: {name} has died of cryo-fever. The blankets were not enough.
{name} has died of cryo-fever. It was quiet and cold, as expected.
{name} has died of cryo-fever. The thermostat was set to its highest.
scurvy: {name} has died of scurvy. Yes, still.
{name} has died of scurvy. A single orange would have embarrassed the disease.
{name} has died of scurvy, in the twenty-second century, aboard a ship with a pantry.
radiation-sickness: {name} has died of radiation sickness. The manual said this would not happen.
{name} has died of radiation sickness. The suit is still in the locker.
{name} has died of radiation sickness. The storm was brief. The aftermath was not.
exhaustion: {name} has died of exhaustion. The drives did not even blink.
{name} has died of exhaustion. They asked for one more hour of sleep.
{name} has died of exhaustion. The log says the pace was reasonable.
decompression-injury: {name} has died of a decompression injury. The crossing took its toll.
{name} has died of a decompression injury. It looked like a bruise at first.
{name} has died of a decompression injury. The suit seals were checked afterward.
micrometeorite-puncture: {name} has died of a micrometeorite puncture. It was a very small thing.
{name} has died of a micrometeorite puncture. The pebble kept going.
{name} has died of a micrometeorite puncture. Space is mostly empty, but not there.
starvation: {name} has died of starvation. The rations ran out before the Lane did.
{name} has died of starvation. The ledger shows a very clear zero.
{name} has died of hunger. The paste was long gone.
hazard: {name} was lost in the crossing. The ship made it. They did not.
{name} has been lost in the hazard. The buoy bulletin called it an incident.
{name} did not come through the crossing. The crew held a moment of quiet.
drift: {name} drifted off and did not come back.
{name} floated out of sight and out of range. The tether was found, loose.
{name} stepped out for a look and kept going. No one saw where.
hull_fire: {name} was lost in the galley fire. The extinguishers were not enough.
{name} has died in the fire aft. The hull held, which is something.
{name} did not come out of the burning compartment. The crew did what it could.
adrift: The drives are gone and the Lane is far. The ship drifts on, and so does the crew.
No drives, no hope of tow. The ship coasts toward a long and quiet end.
The last drive is dead. The ship will be found, in time, by someone.
